title: Sonic Mania
shortDescription: Sonic Mania helps define a Nintendo Switch platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference platformer marker within the Nintendo Switch catalog.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Registered for the Nintendo Switch platformer discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains source-aware discovery without copied review text.
